description.en: The Supabase plugin for DeepSeek Harness, published from github.com/sobhanb-eth/dsh-supabase. The index lists the current release only.
description.zh: 来自 github.com/sobhanb-eth/dsh-supabase 的 DeepSeek Harness Supabase 插件。本索引仅列出当前版本。

description.en: Connect agents to Supabase projects with MCP tools, the official Supabase and Postgres agent skills, browser or token sign-in, and safety guardrails for destructive SQL and chargeable operations.
description.zh: 通过 MCP 工具、官方 Supabase 与 Postgres 智能体技能、浏览器或令牌登录，以及针对破坏性 SQL 与计费操作的安全护栏，把智能体连接到 Supabase 项目。
